reset.subject: Reset your password - We-Fly
reset.preheader: Set a new password. The link is good for {expiresIn}.
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password on your We-Fly account. Choose a new one below.

reset.tipsIntro: While you're here, a good password is:

reset.tipNeverShared: Never shared with anyone. We will never ask for it by email
reset.tipTwoFactor: Backed by two-factor authentication wherever it's offered
reset.text:
Reset your password

We received a request to reset your password for your We-Fly account.

Click this link to create a new password:
{url}

This link will expire in {expiresIn}.

Security Notice: If you didn't request a password reset, please ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged.

For your security, we recommend:
- Using a strong, unique password
- Not sharing your password with anyone
- Enabling two-factor authentication when available

welcome.subject: Welcome to We-Fly! 🪂
welcome.preheader: Your account is live. Time to fill that logbook.
welcome.heading: Welcome aboard, {name}.
welcome.verified: Your email is verified and your account is active. Everything's ready for your first flight.
welcome.featuresIntro: Here's what We-Fly does with an IGC file:
welcome.featureDecode: Decodes the track: thermals, wind, climb phases and flight quality
welcome.featureMap: Puts every flight on a map, with altitude profiles and full statistics
welcome.featureProgress: Tracks your progress: season recap, XC distance history, personal records
welcome.featureCommunity: Connects you to the community: sites, clubs, and where pilots are flying
welcome.closing: Happy flying. We can't wait to see where your adventures take you.
welcome.text:
Welcome aboard, {name}!

Your email has been verified and your account is now active. You're all set to start tracking your paragliding flights!

Here's what you can do with We-Fly:
- Upload and analyze your IGC flight files
- View detailed flight statistics and maps
- Track your progress over time
- Share flights with the community

Sign in now: {url}

Happy flying! We can't wait to see where your adventures take you.

---

We-Fly - Track your paragliding flights
Questions? Contact us at {supportUrl}

onboardingNudge.subject: Your logbook is waiting for its first flight
onboardingNudge.preheader: Flying XCTrack? Set up auto-sync once and every flight lands in We-Fly on its own.
onboardingNudge.heading: Hi {name}, your logbook is still empty
onboardingNudge.openingRecent: You joined We-Fly a little while ago, but no flight has landed in your logbook yet. Most pilots already have a season or two sitting on their instrument, so here is the quickest way to bring it in.
onboardingNudge.openingOld: You joined We-Fly a while back, but your logbook is still waiting for its first flight. Most pilots already have a season or two sitting on their instrument, so here is the quickest way to bring it in.
onboardingNudge.stepPasswordDetail: In We-Fly, open Profile → Connected services and tap Generate on the Instrument & cloud sync card. On a laptop? Scan it onto your phone with the QR code.
onboardingNudge.stepFolderSyncDetail: Install FolderSync from the Play Store and add a WebDAV account with the details below.
onboardingNudge.stepPairTitle: Pair it with your Tracklogs folder
onboardingNudge.stepPairDetail: Upload only, from {path}. Android 11 or later hides that folder; <link>this two-minute guide</link> unlocks it.
onboardingNudge.panelTitle: Set it up once, never upload again
onboardingNudge.panelIntro: FolderSync watches XCTrack's tracklog folder and hands every new flight to We-Fly as soon as you're back on Wi-Fi. Your whole archive comes along too, and duplicates are skipped.

deletion.subject: Your We-Fly account has been deleted
deletion.preheader: Deleted after 3+ years of inactivity. Last login: {date}.
deletion.body: We are writing to inform you that your We-Fly account has been permanently deleted due to inactivity.
deletion.retention: A pseudonymized audit record of this deletion will be retained for 7 years for compliance purposes. This record does not contain any personally identifiable information.
deletion.comeBack: If you wish to use We-Fly again in the future, you are welcome to <link>create a new account</link>.
deletion.legal: Questions about this deletion or our data retention policy? Contact us at <mail>{address}</mail>. This email was sent in accordance with our Data Retention Policy and GDPR requirements.
deletion.text:
Hi {name},

We are writing to inform you that your We-Fly account has been permanently deleted due to inactivity.

Account Deletion Details:
- Last login: {date}
- Reason: 3+ years of inactivity (GDPR Article 5(1)(e) - Storage Limitation)

What was deleted:
- Your account and profile information
- All flight data and GPS tracks
- All consent records

A pseudonymized audit record of this deletion will be retained for 7 years for compliance purposes. This record does not contain any personally identifiable information.

If you wish to use We-Fly again in the future, you are welcome to create a new account at {registerUrl}.

If you have any questions about this deletion or our data retention policy, please contact us at {address}.

Best regards,
The We-Fly Team

---
This email was sent in accordance with our Data Retention Policy and GDPR requirements.

warning.subject: Your We-Fly account will be deleted in 6 months - Action Required
warning.preheader: Log in once and the inactivity counter resets. That is all it takes.
warning.noticed: We noticed that you haven't logged into your We-Fly account in over 2.5 years.
warning.policy: According to our Data Retention Policy (GDPR Article 5(1)(e) - Storage Limitation), accounts with no login activity for 3 consecutive years will be automatically deleted.
warning.notice: Your account will be permanently deleted in approximately 6 months. This will happen if you don't log in before the 3-year inactivity threshold.
warning.button: Log in to keep my account
warning.reset: Logging in will reset the inactivity counter and prevent automatic deletion.
warning.legal: Questions? Contact us at <mail>{address}</mail>. Note: A pseudonymized deletion audit record will be retained for 7 years for compliance purposes.
warning.text:
Hi {name},

We noticed that you haven't logged into your We-Fly account in over 2.5 years.

According to our Data Retention Policy (GDPR Article 5(1)(e) - Storage Limitation), accounts with no login activity for 3 consecutive years will be automatically deleted.

Your account will be permanently deleted in approximately 6 months if you don't log in.

What will be deleted:
- Your account and profile information
- All flight data and GPS tracks
- All consent records

To prevent deletion, simply log in to your account:
{loginUrl}

Logging in will reset the inactivity counter and prevent automatic deletion.

If you have any questions, please contact us at {address}.

Best regards,
The We-Fly Team

---
Note: A pseudonymized deletion audit record will be retained for 7 years for compliance purposes.
